  │ Navigation                                                                                   │  
  │   ↑ k          select the previous tool call; other tabs: scroll up                          │  
  │   ↓ j          select the next tool call; other tabs: scroll down                            │  
  │   Enter        expand or collapse the selected tool call                                     │  
  │   e            expand or collapse every tool call                                            │  
  │   PgUp         scroll up a page                                                              │  
  │   PgDn         scroll down a page                                                            │

  │ Tabs                                                                                         │  
  │   Tab          the next tab                                                                  │  
  │   Shift+Tab    the previous tab                                                              │
